plain: A separate check wrapped around a model that screens what goes in or comes out and blocks or fixes anything off-limits.
eli5: A grown-up who reads your note before it goes out and crosses out the rude words.
technical: A filter layer outside the model's weights, such as a classifier, rule set or second model, applied to inputs, outputs or tool calls; it raises an attacker's cost but is itself bypassable by adaptive attacks.
